Per-card layout via .collectionCard1-.collectionCard4 scoped selectors. bgPattern rotated decorative element. Responsive: 1100px (stack cards, unify label overlay centering), 680px (compact). 383 lines.

nodes.name: typography.css

nodes.name: variables.css
nodes.summary: Design tokens as CSS custom properties on :root. Brand palette: burgundy (#721311), deep-red (#730707), panel-red (#870e0b), wine (#4f0d0c), bright-red (#e3302c). Accent: gold (#ffd400) with multi-stop gold-gradient. Neutrals: ink (#101828), muted (#4a5565), cream (#f0f0f0). AI page tokens (ai-page-bg, ai-badge-bg, ai-upload-border, etc.). Gold gradient linear-gradient. Home drum animation vars (--home-drum-size, offsets, opacity). Font: Inter.
